hero.title: Credit sales, customers and invoices in one app
hero.subtitle: Tavio brings credit sales, CRM, invoicing and stock together for Algerian shops, in French and Arabic.

pain.title: Are your customer credits still in notebooks?

items.problem: Due dates are forgotten and unpaid balances pile up
items.solution: Every instalment is tracked, with a reminder sent to the customer.

items.problem: Invoices are written by hand and the totals never add up
items.solution: Invoices and VAT are calculated automatically, ready to print.

items.problem: Customers and stock are scattered across paper and phones
items.solution: One customer file and one stock, always up to date.

modules.title: All your modules, connected
modules.body: Turn on what your shop needs. Modules share the same customers, products and invoices.

items.title: Credit sales
items.body: Instalment plans, due dates and payment reminders.

items.title: CRM
items.body: Sales pipeline, interaction history and prospect follow-up.

items.title: Sales and invoicing
items.body: Quotes, purchase orders and invoices that follow VAT rules.

items.title: Stock and purchases
items.body: Warehouses, supplier receipts and stock-out alerts.

items.title: Accounting
items.body: Journals, entries and reports based on the SCF chart of accounts.

items.title: Point of sale (POS)
items.body: Fast counter checkout, cash sessions and receipts.

items.title: Human resources
items.body: Employees, leave and attendance for your team.

items.title: Website and shop
items.body: An online storefront connected to your stock and orders.

algeria.title: Built for Algeria
algeria.body: The realities of Algerian trade are built in from day one.

items.title: Algerian dinar (DZD)
items.body: Prices, payments and reports in dinars, with no conversion.

items.title: Algerian VAT
items.body: VAT rates and mentions on your invoices and sales.

items.title: SCF chart of accounts
items.body: An accounting structure that follows the French-style SCF standard.

items.title: NIF and RC
items.body: NIF and trade register fields on invoices, to be checked with your accountant.

items.title: CCP, bank transfer and cash
items.body: Record payments by CCP, bank transfer or cash.

items.title: Works on basic phones
items.body: A lightweight interface for modest devices and weak connections.

items.title: Create your space
items.body: Register your shop and choose your modules.

items.title: Import your data
items.body: Add products, customers and stock, then invite your team.

items.title: Sell and get paid
items.body: Sell on credit or at the counter, invoice and track payments.

ai.title: AI helpers, if you want them
ai.body: An assistant can write payment reminders, summarise your sales or answer questions about your products. It is optional and works with any AI provider you choose.

pricing.title: Simple prices, in dinars
pricing.body: One price per user per month. Prices are indicative and will be confirmed before launch.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your data is hosted in Europe, or on your own servers in the on-premise version. You remain the owner of your data.

items.question: Can I use Tavio in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is available in Arabic, French and English, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.question: How many users can I add?
items.answer: It depends on your plan, from 1 to 25 users.

items.question: Are the invoices compliant in Algeria?
items.answer: Tavio applies Algerian VAT and provides NIF and RC fields. Ask your accountant to validate your invoice template.

items.question: Can I run Tavio on my own servers?
items.answer: Yes. The on-premise offer keeps your data in Algeria, with Docker installation, backups and support.

cta.title: Ready to leave the notebooks behind?
cta.body: Create your space in a few minutes and start with the free plan.
